item.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. and Iran Agree in Principle to Reopen Strait of Hormuz, U.S. Official Says
item.description: The official said Iran had also agreed to dispose of highly enriched uranium, but stressed that a deal had not yet been signed. American and Iranian officials have described the terms differently.

item.title: What to Know About the Potential U.S.-Iran Peace Deal
item.description: President Trump said on Saturday that an agreement to end the war was “largely negotiated,” but neither the United States nor Iran released many details of the proposal.

item.title: Israeli Leaders Say Little About Trump’s Potential Iran Deal
item.description: Analysts said the near silence reflected worries that an agreement will not significantly degrade Iran’s nuclear and missile capabilities.

item.title: Fate of War in Lebanon Rests Mostly With Outside Powers
item.description: A U.S.-Iran peace deal could calm the conflict in Lebanon between Israel and Hezbollah. But that will depend mainly on what the United States, Iran and Israel decide.

item.title: Middle East war live: Trump says US will not ‘rush into a deal’ to end Iran war
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Sunday said he had told US representatives not to rush into a deal with Iran, calling for both sides to “take their time and get it right”. Trump said the US blockade on Iran’s ports would remain in place until a deal was reached. Follow our liveblog for all the latest updates.

item.title: Kyiv, Ukraine, Hit in Russian Missile Attack
item.description: Buildings rattled in the Ukrainian capital for hours early Sunday. Russia launched an Oreshnik intermediate-range ballistic missile for only the third time in the war.

item.title: Rubio Says Details on Iran Nuclear Program Still to Be Negotiated
item.description: The Secretary of State said the United States was prepared to begin those talks if Iran opens the Strait of Hormuz as part of an apparently emerging deal on the war.

item.title: Shrinking snowfall on Greece's mountains is provoking anxiety, altering the economy
item.description: In Arachova, a Greek village reliant on snowmelt, water scarcity is becoming a concern

item.title: Iran Projects Victory in Potential Deal With Washington
item.description: Iran’s leaders argue that the possible preliminary agreement has not extracted any major concessions.

item.title: Russia’s overnight barrage on Ukraine includes use of powerful Oreshnik missile
item.description: At least two people died in Kyiv, which faced the brunt of the attack, Ukrainian officials said. It was one of the biggest overnight aerial assaults since the beginning of Russia's invasion.
